description: List Hyperliquid perpetual markets with mark/oracle price, hourly + annualized funding, open interest, and 24h volume. Use to discover valid coin symbols and scan the board. Supports name filter, sorting, and pagination.

dex.description: HIP-3 builder dex to list (e.g. 'xyz'); omit for the main dex.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring match on coin symbol (e.g. 'BTC').

sort.description: Sort field (desc for numeric, asc for name).

name: hl_get_markets
